summary: Tested this session's new Standard Cost feature end-to-end (backend SAP OData chain + frontend button/columns), whole-cell click-to-expand, and two data-accuracy regression fixes for BOM 5989828. All features work correctly against live SAP. Created backend/tests/test_bom_and_costs.py (11 tests, all passing). Also smoke-tested Export to Excel and Expand/Collapse All per instructions.

ui_bugs.issue: Playwright's force=True click occasionally fails to trigger the onClick handler on these buttons (no network request fired, button state unchanged) even though the button is visible/enabled with no overlay. A normal (non-force) click always worked reliably. This may only be a Playwright force-click quirk with React's synthetic event system and not visible to real users, but flagging since 'force=True' clicks failed 2/2 times while normal clicks succeeded 4/4 times on the same elements.

critical_code_review_comments: sap_valuation_client.py is well-documented and structured; batching via ThreadPoolExecutor for the 2-hop OData chain is reasonable for 100+ component BOMs.
Frontend cost lookup keys costs dict by uppercased product_uuid consistently (backend also returns uppercased keys) - verified this matches correctly, no case-mismatch bug found.

No loading/error state shown per-row if a specific SAP OData batch chunk fails (whole request throws if HTTP != 200) - acceptable given HTTPException handling exists at endpoint level with toast error surfaced to user.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 pytest, after bumping one timeout from 30s->60s for slow invalid-BOM SAP lookup)

test_credentials: N/A - no app-level auth, SAP creds are server-side only in backend/.env, not needed for testing.
seed_data_creation: None - all tests used existing live SAP data (BOM P26584_3, BOM 5989828_4).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified this session's new items thoroughly: (1) whole Product ID cell click-to-expand works for rows with children, and rows without children correctly have no cursor-pointer/onClick (confirmed via class inspection on FLAP3943 cell); (2) Load Standard Costs button flow works end-to-end - live values matched exactly: MPS-B = INR 4004.12, ZINC-ING = INR 386.21, EXT COST = STD*qty computed correctly (e.g. MPS-B ext = INR 1.85, ZINC-ING ext = INR 8.88); button label correctly transitions Load Standard Costs -> Loading Costs... -> Refresh Costs, and re-clicking (refresh) twice in a row re-fetches correctly; (3) switching to a different BOM (5989828) correctly resets STD/EXT COST columns back to '—' placeholder and resets button label back to 'Load Standard Costs' - no cost leakage between BOMs confirmed; (4) BOM 5989828 regression checks passed - item '5989828-24' shows qty=2.0 EA (not stale C01-IPRT2024/0.24), item 'HRPO1.8X45.1' shows qty=0.1 MASS (not stale COIL1.15X50/0.08) - both verified via backend JSON and rendered DOM. Export to Excel and Expand/Collapse All regression-checked fine. No bugs found in the new feature set.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no functional bugs found. The only observation was a Playwright force=True click reliability quirk (test-tooling related, not an app bug) - normal clicks always worked.
